---
title: "Senegal Rural/Urban analysis | SURGO × Manitoba"
output:
  html_document:
    template: ../../support/report.html
    theme: null
    mathjax: null
    self_contained: false
    keep_md: false
    pandoc_args: ["--wrap=none"]
params:
  join_dir: ""
  cache_dir: "data/cache"
  input_zip: !r Sys.getenv("SURGO_MANITOBA_INPUT_ZIP", "")
  work_dir: "output/build/rural_urban/senegal"
  python: !r Sys.getenv("SURGO_MANITOBA_PYTHON", "python3")
  prepared_fragment: ""
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Dependencies and datasets: docs/RUN_GUIDE.md and docs/DATASET_FILENAMES.md.
# Matching R entry orchestrates input preparation and models; this template renders its results.
# Restore packages once with Rscript setup.R; inputs are runtime parameters.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE)
root<-normalizePath("../..",mustWork=TRUE)
definition_options <- options(surgo.define_only = TRUE)
tryCatch(source("Senegal_rural_urban_updated.R"), finally = options(definition_options))
fragment<-params$prepared_fragment
if(!nzchar(fragment)){
 report<-build_senegal_rural_urban(root,params$join_dir,params$cache_dir,
  params$work_dir,params$python,params$input_zip)
 fragment<-report$fragment
}
```

```{r report, results='asis'}
cat("```{=html}\n")
cat(readLines(fragment,warn=FALSE,encoding="UTF-8"),sep="\n")
cat("\n```\n")
```
